summary: Backend-only testing of attendance-gate on POST /api/harvests. Created 5 pytest cases covering: (1) harvest blocked when worker has no check-in today, (2) attendance check precedes product check, (3) invalid product still returns 'Producto no válido' after check-in, (4) harvest succeeds after check-in, (5) check-in today does not satisfy harvest for a different date. ALL 5 TESTS PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1494 lines — recommend splitting into routers (workers, harvests, attendance, products) for maintainability.
In create_harvest the error message hardcodes 'hoy' but the check uses data.date which could be any date; message is slightly misleading when date != today. Minor UX issue.
ObjectId(data.worker_id) in error-path fallback (line 628) could raise if client sends an invalid worker_id — would surface as 500 instead of 400. Consider try/except.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEST_AttGate_<timestamp> worker and deletes it in teardown. One successful harvest is created in test_harvest_succeeds_after_checkin and deleted. Attendance records for today for TEST workers remain (acceptable, worker is deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance-gate on /api/harvests is working as specified. Spanish detail 'no tiene entrada registrada hoy' is returned with 400. Attendance check runs before product validation. test_attendance_gate.py is reusable for regression.
